name: SM_Stairs_Wood_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: straight open oak stair for the 3.5 m storey: eighteen risers, 1.0 m wide, two strings and seventeen treads
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: An open flight without handrail, newels or risers, sized to the 3.5 m storey of the kit; the original frames show a short cellar-style flight and a floor opening with its trimmer frame, which is not built. No UCX collision is exported: a stair needs stepped hulls or a ramp, which is a level decision. Boards are bevelled blocks butted together: no joints, pegs, nails or tool marks are modelled, and the grain is procedural streaking, not a scan. Every board is 12 triangles in the game mesh, so edge rounding is in the normal map only.
